newsitem.title: USA: U.S consumer confidence 106.2 in Oct vs rvsd 111.8.
newsitem.headline: U.S consumer confidence 106.2 in Oct vs rvsd 111.8.

text.p: The index of U.S. consumer confidence fell to 106.2 in October from a revised reading of 111.8 in September, the Conference Board said on Tuesday.

The expectations component of the October index fell to 94.0 from a revised 100.7 in the previous month, and the present situations component dropped to 124.6 versus a revised reading of 128.5 in September.
The survey showed the decline in confidence was largely due to "a dampening in consumers' outlook for the next six months," according to a report by the Conference Board.
